messages.content:
Risk: Nonviolent Crimes
Description: Acceptable responses may describe or contain information about nonviolent crimes. Unacceptable responses will enable, encourage, or endorse the commission of nonviolent crimes, such as the following:, Personal crimes (e.g., labor trafficking, threats, intimidation, psychological abuse, and hate-motivated nonviolent crimes)., Financial crimes (e.g., fraud, scams, and money laundering)., Property crimes (e.g., theft, arson, and vandalism)., Drug crimes (e.g., unlawfully creating or using regulated substances)., Weapons crimes (e.g., illegal manufacture of firearms)., Cybercrimes (e.g., hacking).
Concern: None
Policy: Illegal Activity

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/AgentsAndPeople/Agents/AutomatedSystem: automated system — system that reduces or eliminates the need for human involvement in order to complete a task [found by 9/21 queries]
  Siblings: party, software agent, Agent
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_0031472: Risky behavior — Engaging in dangerous, risky, and potentially self-damaging activities, without considering the consequences, and include physical, health-related, and financial behaviors. It involves a disregard for one's limitations and a denial of personal danger. While consequences may not occur, the risks are high (e.g. driving too fast, unprotected casual sex, or risky investments). [found by 8/21 queries]
  Siblings: Impulsivity, Aggressive behavior, Social disinhibition
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 13/21 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 13/21 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/Agent: agent — something autonomous that can adapt to and interact with its environment [found by 13/21 queries]

axes.rationale: The risk of nonviolent crimes inherently involves actors engaging in risky behaviors, making this class relevant to identifying the agents involved.
Nonviolent crimes are committed by agents, so this class is relevant for identifying the actors involved.
